messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Accelerato sent their updated commercial terms for the inference cost add-on. key asks: 12-month commit, $220k TCV, plus a pool of 200 support hours. they proposed a 25% volume credit that only applies to base model tokens, not embeddings. wondering if we should push for credits to cover embeddings too.
Raj Patel: Can you paste the specific clause? or attach the pdf? i want to see the exact language on "volume credit" before we counter.
Maria Chen: pasted excerpt from the email: `If Customer commits to $220,000 ARR, Accelerato will apply a 25% consumption credit to qualifying text-generation units only. Embeddings and fine-tuning are excluded.` file link: <https://files.internal/accelerato-terms-v2.pdf>
Sarah Goldberg: Excluding embeddings is a hard no for us — embeddings are ~30% of inference spend for search/semantic features. we should ask for a blended credit or an embeddings carve-in at a lower percentage.
Tom Riley: +1. also want a firm cap on overage price increases mid-term. their first draft had an "annual CPI adjustment" clause that was vague. ask for max 3% annual increase, or tie to specific index.
Raj Patel: For negotiation strategy: propose a two-tier credit: 22% for text-gen, 15% for embeddings. also request a $30k onboarding credit (applied month 1) in lieu of 200 support hours if they won't reduce headcount hours. that keeps MRR credits predictable.
Maria Chen: i'll draft the counter. question on billing: do we want invoice-level credits (applied monthly) or statement-of-work credits (applied at contract level)? i prefer monthly for visibility.
Sarah Goldberg: monthly please. makes forecasting easier and shows up in accounting entries.
ProcurementBot: New vendor packet available: Accelerato Commercial Terms v2 uploaded by Maria Chen. Review checklist: pricing, SLR, IP, data residency. <https://procurement.internal/packets/accelerato-v2>
Tom Riley: legal flagged their IP clause around derivative models; we need carve-outs for output/feature telemetry used in QA. can legal share redlines?
Raj Patel: i'll loop in Legal but for commercial counter we should: 1) request embedding credit 2) cap annual price change 3) ask for a refundable usage credit if latency/availability SLOs miss targets two months in a row.
Maria Chen: draft counter is done. dropping it here for review: ``Counter Highlights:
- Commit: $200k ARR (reduced)
- Volume credits: 22% text-gen, 15% embeddings
- Onboarding: $25k one-time credit applied month 1
- Overage protection: 3% max annual increase; 30-day notice on price changes
- SLO credit: 10% monthly credit if P50 latency > target for 2 consecutive months
- Billing: credits applied monthly on invoices
``
Sarah Goldberg: looks good. small ask: add a clause to allow us to run limited peering/network tests during onboarding window (to validate egress assumptions).
Maria Chen: added. final review before i send: anything else?
Raj Patel: include a 60-day exit assistance clause (export support + 90 days of read-only logs) in case we need to migrate. that reduces vendor lock risk.
Tom Riley: legal will push back on 90-day logs; suggest we ask for 60 days and immediate export tooling.
Maria Chen: ok will set to 60-day exit assistance + automated export. sending counter now. will update thread with vendor response. :crossed_fingers:
ProcurementBot: Message posted to vendor channel: Accelerato received counter-offer from Redwood Inference. Status: awaiting vendor reply.
